translations.ctemQueue.subtitle: Choose what to address first. Review the evidence, remediate, then verify.
translations.ctemQueue.helpTitle: From a finding to a verified outcome
translations.ctemQueue.helpIntro: This is a prioritized work queue, not a compliance score or proof of exploitation.
translations.ctemQueue.stepReviewBody: Open a finding to inspect its affected location, source evidence and priority context.
translations.ctemQueue.stepFixBody: Read the available fix steps, assign an external finding, or open the remediation queue.
translations.ctemQueue.stepVerifyBody: Marking a finding fixed records a claim and requests verification; it does not prove that the risk is resolved.
translations.ctemQueue.scoreHelp: Priority is supplied by the Engine on a 0–100 scale; higher values are addressed first. KEV and EPSS are context, not proof of exploitation on this asset.
translations.ctemQueue.scopeHelp: Search, filters and grouping apply to the loaded window. Load more when additional server results are available. Quiet low-severity findings are hidden by default and can be included.
translations.ctemQueue.recommendationMissing: No fix steps supplied. Review the source evidence before deciding how to remediate.
translations.ctemQueue.breakdownMissing: The source has not supplied a score breakdown. No browser estimate is shown.
translations.ctemQueue.empty: No findings in this loaded queue
translations.ctemQueue.emptyBody: This is not an all-clear verdict. Review source coverage and the active filters.
translations.ctemQueue.confirmFixedBody: {count} selected findings will be marked fixed. Only a successful verification can establish the final outcome.
translations.ctemQueue.confirmFalse: Mark this finding as a false positive?
translations.ctemQueue.confirmFalseBody: Only continue after reviewing the evidence. This changes the recorded finding state.
translations.ctemQueue.binderHint: Export available evidence for the selected framework. An export is not a compliance certification.
translations.ctemQueue.enrichmentError: Additional code context could not be loaded. Priority results remain available.
translations.ctemQueue.assignmentHint: Only external findings support assignment here. Code findings stay selected and are not assigned.
translations.ctemQueue.selectionStale: Some selected findings are no longer in the loaded snapshot. Refresh and select them again.
translations.ctemQueue.assignSummary: Assigned {succeeded} to {assignee}; {failed} failed, {skipped} code findings skipped.
